backend.call: PutObject: an attachment stored
CreateMultipartUpload, UploadPart, CompleteMultipartUpload: a large file in parts
AbortMultipartUpload: a part upload that failed
HeadObject: whether a file is there before it is deleted
DeleteObject: a file deleted
GetObject: a file streamed back through the server

frontend.call: The browser opens a file's presigned download link (getSignedUrl over GetObject, with ResponseContentType and ResponseContentDisposition)

optional.what: S3 file storage (opt-in); the customer life deliberately configures it

backend.call: GetObject: a file read
PutObject: a file written
Upload (lib-storage): a streamed file, one PutObject when it is under a part, else CreateMultipartUpload, UploadPart and CompleteMultipartUpload, AbortMultipartUpload when a part fails
HeadObject: a file's metadata
DeleteObject: a file deleted
CopyObject: a file moved or copied (then the source deleted)
ListObjectsV2: a folder's files
DeleteObjects: a folder emptied in one request
GetObject, DeleteObject: an inbound email SES stored, read and removed
